description: This file defines a TreeFragment class for an Android application, responsible for displaying a hierarchical list of tasks and activities in an expandable list format. It manages UI components like RecyclerView and observes a ViewModel for data updates.

classes.name: TreeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a hierarchical list of tasks and activities, allowing expansion and UI updates based on a ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and retrieves any arguments such as the title for display.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and sets up an observer to refresh the UI when data changes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Triggers an action in the ViewModel, e.g., showing a Floating Action Button.

methods.name: onResumeHelper
methods.description: Updates UI elements, such as the title and RecyclerView, when data is received.

methods.name: displayRecycler
methods.description: Configures and sets an adapter and layout manager for the RecyclerView to display tasks.

methods.name: openTask
methods.description: Expands a specific task group to show its child tasks or activities.
